fusions.name: Linked Lash
fusions.desc: Lashes your tongue at the first enemy within 6 tiles for 5 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each for 60% of the damage.

fusions.name: Passed Down the Line
fusions.desc: Whips your tail in a ring, dealing 10 poison damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving them [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Reeling Tongue
fusions.desc: Lays your tongue out in a line 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound Prey
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, you deal 12% more damage.
